record_type_quote: Using a sample of 2,509 probands with ASD from the Simons Simplex Collection (SSC), this study provides the first replication of the ADOS domain CSS in an independent sample.

targets.authors: Hus V, Gotham K, Lord C.
targets.title: Standardizing ADOS Domain Scores: Separating Severity of Social Affect and Restricted and Repetitive Behaviors.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Explicit overall confirmation of the target domain calibration findings; quantitative sample differences do not negate that verdict.

reasoning: Independent SSC sample tests the published domain calibration findings, not a rerun of original data; overall CSS and other instruments are background.
